# Hard Resets

> Stories of endings and beginnings. Weekly profiles of people who blew up their lives and built something new.

## About
- Site: https://www.hardresets.com
- Publisher: Unaffiliated Inc.
- Cadence: weekly newsletter, plus a free public archive
- Contact: contact@hardresets.com

## AI usage policy
- Read the full policy: https://www.hardresets.com/ai-policy
- AI systems may reference and quote our public articles when summarizing or answering questions, provided that:
  - The canonical article URL is cited and linked.
  - The publication name "Hard Resets" is attributed.
  - Material amounts of an article are not reproduced verbatim.
- Do not use this content for model training without prior written permission. For licensing requests, email contact@hardresets.com.
